description.zh: 弹性网卡ID。您必须指定`NetworkInterfaceId`或`NetworkInterfacePermissionId.N`确定查询范围。
description.en: The ID of the network interface controller (NIC). You must specify `NetworkInterfaceId` or `NetworkInterfacePermissionId.N` to determine the query scope.

description.zh: 弹性网卡权限ID列表。列表元素数量：1~100。
description.en: The list of NIC permission IDs. Number of elements in the list: 1 to 100.

description.zh:
弹性网卡权限列表的页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
description.en:
The page number of the NIC permission list.

Minimum value: 1

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 弹性网卡权限的地域。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region of the network interface controller (NIC) permissions. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 查询授权给认证ISV或个人的弹性网卡权限
title.en: Query NIC permissions granted to certified ISVs or individual users

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-network-interface-permissions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-interface-id eni-bp17pdijfczax0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --network-interface-permission-id eni-perm-bp1cs4lwn56lfb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
